name: A10-0107/2026 – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – § 49 – Am 15
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text: 49. Welcomes the signing, on 5 April 2024, of the EU-Uzbekistan memorandum of understanding launching a strategic partnership on critical raw materials; underlines that Uzbekistan ranks among the world’s leading producers of uranium, gold, copper and rare earth elements critical to the EU’s energy security and industrial sovereignty; calls for this partnership to be operationalised through binding supply agreements, joint venture frameworks and priority access for EU companies; welcomes the introduction of an additional EUR 12 billion investment package during the EU-Central Asia Summit in Samarkand in 2025, with EUR 2.5 billion specifically earmarked for critical raw materials;
